subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ What keyword needs to be used to create a new sprite kind?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What keywords and symbols should be used in the code that creates new sprite kinds?


Solution: 

export should be added to the code in namespace on Line 5 so the code reads: 


export let LargeAsteroid = SpriteKind.Create()
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s an error in the code!


Notice that the error message on the bottom says the problem is on Line 80: the property ‘LargeAsteroid’ does not exist on type ‘typeof SpriteKind’.



Fix the bugs in the code so that a LargeAsteroid sprite kind is created when the project starts.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Which sprite kind should be selected in the onCreated event?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which sprite kind should the velocity be set for when a new sprite is created?


Solution: 

The kind parameter in the onCreated event should be changed to SpriteKind.SmallAsteroid.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s an error in the code!


Notice that the error message on the bottom says the problem is on Line 130: the property ‘Asteroid’ does not exist on type ‘typeof SpriteKind’.



Fix the bugs in the code so that when a SmallAsteroid sprite is created, its vx and vy parameters are set to a random integer.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ Which parameter is used in place of the sprite name inside the onCreated event?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which parameter should be used as the sprite name in the onCreated event so that when a new SmallAsteroid sprite is created, there’s a 50% chance that it’s vx and vy values will be multiplied by -1?


Solution: 

otherSprite should be replaced by sprite in the vx and vy code on Lines 134 and 137.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s an error in the code!


Notice that the error message on the bottom says the problems are on Lines 134 and 137: the program cannot find the name ‘otherSprite’.



Fix the bugs in the code so that when a SmallAsteroid sprite is created, there’s a 50% chance that its vx and vy values will be multiplied by -1.

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of Purple Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about sprite kinds and sprite overlap events. In the JavaScript editor, you can use a namespace to create new sprite kinds. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 1:

badges.title: One of a Kind
badges.description: Use sprite kinds and events to control what happens to sprites in a project in JavaScript.

badges.title: A Meeting of the Kinds
badges.description: Use an overlap event that runs based on the sprites’ kinds.

badges.title: Nice Knowing Ya
badges.description: Write code that destroys a sprite.

badges.title: Life of the Party
badges.description: Set the value of the Player’s life.

badges.title: From One Sprite to Another
badges.description: Create a projectile that starts from the position of an existing sprite.

badges.title: Metamorphosis
badges.description: Change the sprite kind of an existing sprite.

badges.title: Kind of You to Join
badges.description: Create a new sprite kind in JavaScript.

badges.title: New Kind on the Block
badges.description: Write code that runs when a sprite with a specific sprite kind is created.

badges.title: Out of Chances
badges.description: Write code that runs when the Player’s life reaches zero.

badges.title: Spice Up Your Life
badges.description: Set the image used to represent the Player’s life.
